# Nailfolio

[English](https://nailfolio.app/llms.txt) | [Polski](https://nailfolio.app/llms-pl.txt) | [Deutsch](https://nailfolio.app/llms-de.txt)

## Useful pages

- [Home](https://nailfolio.app/en/): about Nailfolio
- [For stylists](https://nailfolio.app/en/for-stylists/): portfolio, public profile and client cards
- [For clients](https://nailfolio.app/en/for-clients/): browse styles, save favorites and share an Inspiration Session
- [For salons](https://nailfolio.app/en/for-studios/): shared team portfolio and salon profile
- [Pricing](https://nailfolio.app/en/pricing/): current plans and pricing
- [Compare](https://nailfolio.app/en/compare/): compare Nailfolio with other tools
- [About Nailfolio](https://nailfolio.app/en/about/): product information
- [Contact](https://nailfolio.app/en/contact/): contact form
- [Get the app](https://nailfolio.app/en/get-app/): phone browser use and Android app status
- [Help center](https://nailfolio.app/en/help-center/): answers and instructions
- [Blog](https://nailfolio.app/en/blog/): Nailfolio articles
